notes.title: The New Renova Is Here
notes.content:
Since the original EA launch summer 2021, the dev team has been working deligently to bring players a better and more fulfilling experience!

Since then there has been completely new character models, a large sandbox map, and many new gameplay features.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40829573/42546011c86a5fd9b012fea6121254d1b918079a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40829573/676eb233d7da2492b4fc5ff684616cd3ba7ee6d6.png[/img][/url]

To summarize in detail:

- realistic style character model and armour models

- sandbox map, including a few variant landscapes and hidden features for players to explore

- Interactive Environment System, choose between "Touch", "Speak", or "Look" as you click on any interesting objects in a map to interact with

- More character progression, more armour and weapon, including some very powerful ones :) 

All in one, Renova has grown with this update from "childhood" to "early adult" stage, it is a much richer game compared with previous versions. The dev team sincerely wish you a fun and lovely experience trying out the latest version of Renova!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40829573/76f018840c579557204ecbb5b31ff164ea591a83.png[/img]

notes.title: Early Access V192a1.9
notes.content:
- Completely removed the Action Cool-down Ring, now the game feels more like a standard ARPG
- Skill System expansion, now with five different skills available
- Loot System is now live, with coins, health potions, armors, and a few other items for picking up
- A rudimentary sandbox map is now live, with a few different zones and NPCs to interact with
